recap.text:
Aiden Ng Carries Newport Select Gold 14U To Victory Over Eckstein
November 20, 2026 vs. Eckstein
Newport Select Gold 14U past Eckstein, 57-46, on Friday at Chief Kanim Middle School as Aiden Ng scored 21 points.
Newport Select Gold 14U controlled the game from the opening tip, never giving up the advantage. The lead reached a peak of 16 points at 20-4.
Newport Select Gold 14U went on a 9-point run to start the game. Newport Select Gold 14U had a strong first half, leading 32-28 at halftime and never looked back, securing the victory.
Newport Select Gold 14U controlled the second half, outscoring Eckstein 25-18.
Newport Select Gold 14U scored at will in the paint. They went 16-31 on twos. Ng and Kalden Sen each hit multiple three-pointers for Newport Select Gold 14U. The team shot 6-17 (35%) from beyond the arc. Newport Select Gold 14U rebounded the ball well, collecting 29 rebounds. Talen Tep led the team with eight rebounds. Newport Select Gold 14U passed the ball well with 10 assists on 22 made baskets. Newport Select Gold 14U pressured the ball all game, collecting 13 steals. Ng led the team with five steals. Sen (12 points), Tep (10 points), Aiden Shih (5 points), Mason Huang (3 points), Uttam Verriach (2 points), Deacon Chun (2 points), and Charles (2 points) also pitched in for Newport Select Gold 14U.
Next up for Newport Select Gold 14U is a game at Tides Select White on Saturday.
